description: When a Vite dev server (or any HTTP server answering 200 non-JSON) holds the client's saved port, `pardner open`, `client open` and `client status` fail with INTERNAL_ERROR and a raw JSON SyntaxError ("Unexpected end of JSON input" with real Vite 4.5.14) instead of PORT_IN_USE.
expected: PORT_IN_USE naming the port and how to move.
actual: INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected end of JSON input — no port, no cause, no fix.
suggested_fix: In the probe, treat any non-JSON or non-Pardner-shaped response as `foreign` (catch the parse error).

description: The foreign-port PORT_IN_USE message says "stop that process or start with --http-port", but `pardner open --http-port 47108` returns the identical error because the probe of the saved port runs before the flag is used.
expected: --http-port is honoured when the saved port is foreign (start on the new port and save it).
actual: Same PORT_IN_USE naming 47107; only stopping the other process or a foreground `client serve --http-port` works.
suggested_fix: When the state is foreign and --http-port is given, skip the saved-port probe and spawn on the requested port; or change the advice to name `pardner client serve --http-port`.

criterion: Component consistency: same error worded the same
description: Two PORT_IN_USE messages with different wording and different fixes: "…is answering but is not this Pardner client; stop that process or start with --http-port" (foreign HTTP) vs "Port 47107 is in use by another process; choose another --http-port" (non-HTTP). Only the second's advice works.
expected: One message and one working fix.
actual: Two wordings; advice works in only one case.
